topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Got a call from some pampered executive, smooth as silk, telling me I'm getting shuffled off to another department. Just what I needed, another desk, another set of books to dust off. They make it sound all chipper, "growth opportunity," he says. Like I'm supposed to thank him for it. It's a game, and I'm supposed to play along, pretend like shuffling papers across a different desk is some kind of grand promotion. Well, I've seen how the game works, seen the pawns they keep moving until they get tired and just sweep them off the board. I'll play, but I won't forget this. Not a jot.
